description: Construction number 235-120 and the last airframe of the 56-2953 to 56-3022 batch; registered N80565 to Flight Systems December 1979 then N405FS and operated by Tracor Flight Systems as a target and support aircraft with the registration cancelled 28 May 2010; to AMARC as FE0642 on 3 March 1993 and released to the Ohio ANG 20 September 1999; recorded pole-mounted at Mansfield December 2001; no sighting found later than 2014 so 2026 presence is unconfirmed
museum_name: Mansfield Lahm Air National Guard Base Static Displays

description: Block F-84F-35-RE; 92nd FBS 81st FBW; 3600th Combat Crew Training Wing; 810th Air Base Group; Indiana ANG 163rd FS 1958; USAF 366th TFW 1962; Ohio ANG 164th FS; placed on display with the Ohio ANG at Mansfield Lahm; no sighting found later than 2014 so 2026 presence is unconfirmed
museum_name: Mansfield Lahm Air National Guard Base Static Displays
